taxon_or_system: Cirsium acaule; C. heterophyllum; C. arvense
sampling: latitudinal population transects; approximately 25 individuals per population
principal_finding: Species with similar contemporary reproduction and isolation showed sharply different geographic genetic patterns; C. acaule lost diversity and diverged at its range edge whereas C. heterophyllum did not.
EAzami_relevance: warns against inferring population history or colour-haplotype geography from present distributions and ecology alone
critical_limit: small marker set and Western European taxa; no genome-wide ancestry

markers_or_data: neutral genetic markers; habitat and fitness measurements
principal_finding: Population size and habitat quality jointly influenced genetic diversity and fitness in a clonal thistle.
EAzami_relevance: shows why population replication habitat quality and clonality should accompany morph sampling rather than treating individuals as independent
critical_limit: conservation/fitness study without genome-wide history and outside focal East Asia

markers_or_data: six microsatellite loci; climatic niche analysis
sampling: 1522 individuals from 58 populations plus approximately 32000 occurrence locations
principal_finding: Multiple introductions from divergent European lineages and subsequent admixture maintained substantial North American diversity despite a bottleneck; climatic niche was broadly conserved.
EAzami_relevance: direct precedent that a phenotype-associated haplotype in a derived range may reflect multiple origins and admixture rather than new mutation or regain
critical_limit: six microsatellites and invasive-species history; not local ancestry at causal loci
data_or_access: Wiley article plus voucher and occurrence supplements

markers_or_data: custom microarray with 63690 ESTs; qPCR validation
sampling: ten populations; five per native/introduced range; control nutrient-deficiency and shade treatments
principal_finding: Expression divergence and treatment-by-range responses supported distinct life-history/stress strategies and two North American introduction histories.
EAzami_relevance: methodological precedent for combining demographic origin with expression plasticity; relevant to interpreting floral RNA differences after population structure is known
critical_limit: microarray and nonfloral treatments; not a causal genomic mapping study

markers_or_data: seven microsatellite loci; contemporary and historical landscape resistance
sampling: 24 populations across the centre and periphery of the range
principal_finding: Moderate structure and a north-south diversity pattern reflected both postglacial colonization and contemporary/historical habitat corridors.
EAzami_relevance: shows that present spatial proximity and historical routes can make different predictions for allele geography; bridge sampling should follow plausible colonization corridors
critical_limit: seven loci and one narrow endemic; no trait association or causal ancestry

principal_finding: Populations were significantly differentiated with FST 0.21; two genetic groups and admixed populations occurred while measured environment/geography explained little.
EAzami_relevance: supports testing admixture directly instead of assuming environmental similarity identifies shared ancestry
critical_limit: small regional extent and microsatellite resolution; invasive clonal species
data_or_access: International Journal of Plant Sciences and institutional repository

markers_or_data: AFLP; STRUCTURE; flow cytometry; chromosomes; morphometrics
sampling: 235 individuals across ten species and two hybrid combinations from 106 localities
principal_finding: Confirmed recurrent introgressive hybridization with C. acaulon and C. erisithales and corrected the chromosome number of C. bertolonii.
EAzami_relevance: strong warning that a species-tree tip and morphology can be decoupled by local gene flow; motivates local ancestry and cytotype screening
critical_limit: dominant markers and regional system; not a reusable genome-wide backbone
data_or_access: open Springer article and online resources
